question.:question/problem:
Given that

$$
C=\begin{bmatrix}-12 & 1 & 2 \\ 3 & -4 & 2 \\ 0 & -2 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$

which of the following elementary row operations makes $a_{21}=0$?
question.:question/worked-solution:
Of the given options, we consider the row operation

$$
{R}_{2}↔{R}_{3}.
$$

The entry in row $3$, column $1$ is $0$. Switching rows $2$ and $3$ therefore makes $a_{21}=0$.

Applying the above row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}C &=\begin{bmatrix}-12 & 1 & 2 \\ 3 & -4 & 2 \\ 0 & -2 & -5\end{bmatrix}\qquad {R}_{2}↔{R}_{3} \\ &\sim \begin{bmatrix}-12 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -2 & -5 \\ 3 & -4 & 2\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{2}↔{R}_{3}.
$$
